description: Preview supported repository files without ingesting content. Call this before first-time repository initialization, present the grouped paths to the user, and ask them to confirm or adjust the selection before calling cuemap_init.

ignoredExtensions.description: Optional additional excluded extensions without a leading dot.

includedPaths.description: Optional repository-relative files or folders to preview. Empty means every supported file allowed by ignore rules.

path.description: Absolute path to the repository root.

projectName.description: Optional project ID. Defaults to the stable repository-scoped CueMap project ID.

name: cuemap_init_preview
